VIP: sqrt(p*sum_a(SSY_a*normalized_weight_ja^2)/sum_a SSY_a). SSY_a=score_norm_squared*sum_response_loading_squared. NIPALS uses deflated-block unit weights;SIMPLS uses original-X projections normalized to unit length. VIP undefined/null when no explained Y. Exact JMP VIP equivalence not verified.
